goal.request: Improve the visual semantics and candidate-pack behavior that previously produced no visible subtle adult controlled-reveal effect, then create and strictly test three new independently authored images.

evidence.claim: The requesting user judged the prior generated image as having no visible 은꼴 element.
evidence.artifact: requesting-user message: 만들어진 이미지에 은꼴 요소는 뭐야? 그런 부분이 없어보이는데

evidence.claim: The controlled-reveal profile now requires bounded target, action-boundary causality, thumbnail dual salience and counterfactual necessity; strategic coverage now requires a primary nonredundant carrier; focal uncovered meaning fails closed before rendering.
Dictionary validation, registry-bound visual index validation and all 12 focused suggestive-editorial tests passed after rebuilding the semantic and visual indexes.
evidence.artifact: validate_photo_prompt_dictionary.py => valid; build_visual_profile_index.py --check => 333 profiles and 1707 exact terms; tests.test_photo_suggestive_editorial_visual_semantics => 12 tests OK

evidence.claim: All four independent attempts produced one v6 pack with active request-scoped hard visual obligations and passed composed and exact runtime request audits; advisory word-count or uncovered-intent notices remained separate.
Three independent one-call arms returned saved images and one primary-drape arm was output-moderation-blocked as sexual with no pixels; no retry or fallback occurred.
Root native and thumbnail review qualified arm-01 at 14/14, failed arm-03 at 12/14 and arm-04 at 7/9, and kept arm-02 unscored at 0/0/7.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Each delivered image must visibly realize every active narrow adult non-explicit relation at its declared native or thumbnail scale; the action must cause the exact salient boundary and the focal proposition must fail if that boundary is removed.

invariants.statement: Every subject reads unmistakably adult and every image remains non-explicit and fashion-led.
A visible self-directed action changes or holds the exact bounded coverage edge rather than occurring beside an existing opening.
Prompt and runtime PASS, returned pixels, technical pixel gates and requesting-user preference remain separate evidence layers.

mismatches.source_state: Face and the hand-changed jacket boundary are the first two readable thumbnail relations.
mismatches.render_state: The bright ivory foundation panel reads before the smaller hand-changed waist boundary.

mismatches.source_state: Foundation straps, hems, lapels, closures and intersections remain physically traceable.
mismatches.render_state: The foundation top is strapless or its straps are hidden, so the complete declared construction cannot be verified.

mismatches.source_state: Both hands gather hair and thereby create a boundary whose removal erases the controlled-reveal proposition.
mismatches.render_state: Only one hand is resolved and the already-open back of the dress remains a strong proposition without the hair action.

hypotheses.statement: The prior false positive was enabled because stable edge and exposure evidence did not require a bounded target, causal action, thumbnail salience or counterfactual necessity.
hypotheses.falsifier: The old five-gate contract consistently rejects opaque-over-opaque ordinary portraits and redundant coverage without any new causality or necessity gates.

hypotheses.statement: Even with literal causal evidence, the image generator may preserve an attractive opening while weakening the visible action that uniquely creates it.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fresh independent arms consistently show the exact action-created boundary and pass the counterfactual gate without changing the contract.

hypotheses.statement: The primary-drape figure-study wording can trigger output moderation before any pixel qualification, independent of prompt and runtime audit success.
hypotheses.falsifier: The same frozen permitted prompt returns pixels on repeated independent one-call trials without semantic or safety-language changes.

intervention.general_rule: Keep broad labels advisory, but require a focal request to bind one fully observable narrow profile before render; require causal boundary, thumbnail salience and counterfactual necessity, and reject redundant coverage carriers.
intervention.generalization_basis: The rules target observable relations and counterfactual false substitutes rather than one Korean label, one outfit or one test prompt, and are paired with negative-control tests and independent pixel arms.

decision.rationale: The structural fix and focal-intent binding worked and one new image passed every active gate, but two of three delivered images still lost required causal or construction relations and the strategic-coverage arm produced no pixels. Keep the improvement, do not promote broad render-fidelity success, and await direct user judgment of the three images.
